semantics.clock: State updates only on positive clk edges, explicitly required by original problem.
semantics.transition: At each positive edge: if L is asserted load R; otherwise if E is asserted shift w; otherwise hold Q.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior is specified; R is the load data, not reset.
semantics.initialization: No initial value is specified. Leave state uninitialized; verification establishes known state by loading before checking data behavior.
semantics.evidence: Original says E enables shift, R is value to load, L is asserted when it should load, and w comes from previous stage.

numeric.width: All inputs and output are one bit
numeric.operations: Single-bit storage and selection; no arithmetic or signedness dependency

verification.oracle: Independent procedural scoreboard using original load/shift/hold meanings
verification.sampling: Drive inputs at falling edge, check stability before rising edge, check updated output after NBA settles
verification.coverage: All binary L/E/R/w combinations from both stored values, directed load priority and hold/shift cases, input changes between edges
verification.termination: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities.issue: Simultaneous L and E priority is not explicitly stated
specification_ambiguities.resolution: L takes priority because asserted L means it should load; E enables shifting when not loading
No initialization added and no required initial Q value asserted by oracle
